abstract: ABO blood group was analyzed in 70 patients with hydatidiform mole and 53 patients with malignant trophoblastic disease. 319 healthy pregnant women served as controls. The distribution of ABO blood groups in patients with hydatidiform mole did not deviate significantly from the distribution in the controls. There was a slight excess in group AB and a slight deficiency in group O in patients with hydatidiform mole. However, there was a significant decrease in blood group A and a slight excess in groups O, B and AB in patients with malignant trophoblastic disease compared with the distribution in healthy pregnant women. A higher mortality rate was observed in group B in patients with malignant trophoblastic disease. In conclusion, ABO blood group of patients with malignant trophoblastic disease can be an important prognostic factor in the diagnosis and treatment of the trophoblastic disease, if a large number of cases are compiled by many investigators.
abstract_ja: 胞状奇胎患者70例および悪性絨毛性疾患患者53例のABO血液型を分析した。対照として健常妊婦319例を用いた。胞状奇胎患者におけるABO血液型の分布は、対照と有意な差はなかった。AB型がわずかに多く、O型がわずかに少なかった。しかし、悪性絨毛性疾患患者では、健常妊婦と比較してA型が有意に減少し、O型、B型、AB型がわずかに多かった。悪性絨毛性疾患患者のうちB型では死亡率が高かった。結論として、多数の症例を多くの研究者が集めれば、悪性絨毛性疾患患者のABO血液型は、絨毛性疾患の診断と治療における重要な予後因子となり得る。
